archaeology-gravel-or-sand.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
archaeology-gravel-or-sand.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
archaeology-gravel-or-sand.reason: Suspicious sand is emitted by ordinary desert-well features despite structures=false, and is a brushable state with sandy geometry.

constructed-feature-surfaces.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
constructed-feature-surfaces.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
constructed-feature-surfaces.reason: Structures=false retains ordinary features: wells, monster rooms, End cages, podium torches and gateways. Physical tops and placement outside registered structures do not determine ground role.
constructed-feature-surfaces.recommendation: Exclude chests, spawners, well slabs, cage bars, torches, fire and gateway blocks; retain independently eligible stone/bedrock/obsidian substrate.

coral-reef.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
coral-reef.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
coral-reef.reason: Vanilla represents reef mass, plants, and fans with distinct coral classes. CMS1 excludes non-ground vegetation but does not decide reef-ground eligibility.
coral-reef.recommendation: Include solid coral reef blocks; exclude coral plants and fans.

fossil-surface.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
fossil-surface.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
fossil-surface.reason: Bone fossil template blocks replace buried terrain and may become exposed. They are fossil components rather than living vegetation.

mineral-protrusions.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
mineral-protrusions.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
mineral-protrusions.reason: Mineral growth protrudes into a void instead of replacing the ground substrate; placement alone does not establish Ground Surface eligibility.
mineral-protrusions.recommendation: Include mineral protrusions as ground geometry.

mixed-root-and-soil.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
mixed-root-and-soil.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
mixed-root-and-soil.reason: Muddy mangrove roots combine tree-root and soil roles in one block type, and share RotatedPillarBlock with logs and deepslate.
mixed-root-and-soil.recommendation: Include muddy roots as soil; retain bare mangrove-root exclusion.

sculk-feature-components.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
sculk-feature-components.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
sculk-feature-components.reason: Sculk substrate is ground replacement; sensors, catalysts, shriekers and veins are additional component blocks. CMS1 does not determine their ground role.
sculk-feature-components.recommendation: Exclude components from ground while keeping sculk replacement substrate eligible.

snow-overlay.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
snow-overlay.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
snow-overlay.reason: Snow layers are partial ground coatings. CMS1 preserves partial geometry but does not explicitly make this coating eligible.
snow-overlay.recommendation: Include snow layers and use their authoritative partial geometry.

tree-attached-components.effect_if_excluded: Remove this geometry before choosing the next eligible surface or explicit no-ground.
tree-attached-components.effect_if_included: This geometry can supply the highest eligible surface in a column.
tree-attached-components.reason: Bee nests and creaking hearts are non-vegetation block types embedded in tree/canopy features. Explicit canopy/trunk exclusion does not name these identities.
tree-attached-components.recommendation: Exclude components whose role belongs to the tree/canopy.
